title: Company/domain deployment / SPN / whoami / troubleshooting
meaning: Real Windows Auth behavior depends on the hosting environment, domain membership, browser settings, IIS configuration and service identity.
Kerberos requires correct SPN/service identity configuration; NTLM may appear as fallback when Kerberos cannot be used.
A whoami/claims endpoint is the fastest way to inspect the authenticated principal and group/claim shape.
401 loops or login prompts usually mean the browser/server/domain negotiation failed or the endpoint is not reachable under the expected authentication conditions.
IIS Express/local behavior is not proof that production domain/SPN/app-pool identity is correctly configured.
boundary_notes: R03 covers multi-scheme composition; R04 covers deployment and diagnostics.
Avoid mixing conceptual Windows Auth basics into troubleshooting unless needed to interpret the failure.
